_comment: Chain-tip anchor used to turn a block-height nLockTime into an approximate calendar date. The device has no RTC and no chain tip, so a raw height is uninterpretable on its own. Regenerated by .github/workflows/update-latest-block.yml; safe to hand-edit by copying the height and timestamp of any recent block from a block explorer (e.g. https://mempool.space/block/<hash>). Only month-level accuracy matters, so a stale value is harmless.
